changelog: First release. A track of your own can play under the big edit (a sound event from your resource pack), with `beat_volume` for the built-in beat under it.
name: Kotost Aura
summary: Taking damage turns your game into a meme edit about whoever hurt you: cinematic camera, beat zooms, captions, MOGGED, and aura points.
description:
Get hurt and your screen becomes an edit about the thing that hurt you. A berry bush pricks you: a cool "Berry sigma" climbs out right beside you and the camera cuts on the beat: your face, the void, the character from below, an orbit, the sky, a grey **MOGGED**, a red close-up and a blast. Captions come word by word, the screen zooms, shakes and flashes, and a whoosh comes half a second before the drop.

Every hit costs aura: fire, falls, water, mobs, players, explosions and deaths each take their own amount, and killing the character wins it back with a small revenge edit. A big edit plays at most every `big_edit_cooldown` seconds, smaller hits get a short one; five hits in a row end in **"UNPLAYABLE"** and a few seconds of quiet.

The beat is built from vanilla sounds. To play your own track instead, put it into a resource pack as a sound event (stream) and set `track =` and `bpm =` in `config/kotost_aura.txt`; `beat_volume` sets the vanilla beat under it (0 turns it off). No music is shipped with the mod.

Commands: `/aura` (your aura and the top), `/aura off|on`; operators: `/aura test <berry|fire|fall|water|player|mob|boom|other>`, `/aura give <player> <n>`. Settings: `config/kotost_aura.txt`, aura per player: `config/kotost_aura_players.json`. Captions in Russian (editable in the config).

The grey and red filters are vanilla post chains from the content mod **Kotost Aura Assets** (`kotost_aura_assets`): install it too. No shader pack needed. Needed on the server and the client. No Minecraft code or assets are included. Native source mod: the launcher compiles it after a warning; it runs with your account's permissions.
